memory-layer.description: Memory Layer MCP server for multi-agent memory access

tools.name: search_memories
tools.description: Search for relevant memories by query. Returns memories ranked by relevance and outcome score.

tools.name: add_memory
tools.description: Store a new memory with category. Categories: architecture, convention, decision, pattern, gotcha, workaround, troubleshooting, command, preference.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: Record worked/failed/partial feedback for a memory. This adjusts the outcome score: worked +0.2, failed -0.3, partial +0.05.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Get memories relevant to the current project context, formatted for injection into the conversation.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List memories with optional filters by category, project, or minimum score.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get memory statistics including total count, category distribution, and average outcome scores.
